name: Tomato Bath
summary: A Karnataka-style tomato rice prepared with sona masuri rice, fresh ginger and garlic.

items: 1 standard cup sona masuri rice (0.75 rice cup)

preparation.text: Rinse 1 standard cup sona masuri rice (0.75 rice cup) and soak it for 20 minutes.

cookingMethod.lead: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pressure cooker. Add:

cookingMethod.after: Cook until the tomatoes soften and the oil begins to separate.

cookingMethod.text: Drain and add the soaked 1 standard cup sona masuri rice (0.75 rice cup). Mix gently for 1 minute.

cookingMethod.after: Build pressure on the induction cooktop, then reduce to 100°C / 300 W for 10 minutes. Allow the pressure to release naturally.

cookingMethod.text: Fluff gently and finish with the juice of 1 small lemon.

servingSuggestions: Serve hot with onion-cucumber raita, plain curd or papad.
notes: This is the initial website version and can be replaced with the fully finalized chat version after review.
